method: Every actual SVG text line is independently rasterized at its original font family/weight/size on a transparent temporary SVG sheet. Nonzero alpha pixels reconstruct its actual local glyph-ink bounds. No files or assets are changed by measurement.
limitations: Local glyph metrics use the exact same font stack as the PNG previews. Feishu may substitute fonts or normalize metrics; live inspection remains necessary.
This checks visible glyph bounds rather than invisible text-editing frame estimates. Oversized editing frames do not imply clipped glyphs, and are distinguished from visible content.
The source business strings and compact route semantics are validated in the separate independent coverage report.
